identity: Pure green-blue tempo on Ivy, Gleeful Spellthief. Ivy copies any spell targeting only a single creature other than herself and the copy targets Ivy, so 10 of the 24 nonland cards buff a ground body and a 2/1 flier at once. With no red splash there is no double-strike burst, so the kill is grindier: Combat Research's Aura copy lands on legendary Ivy for +1/+1, ward {1} and a card per connection, and the deck wins by flying over while refuelling. It is threat-dense by design -- 11 creatures -- because Ivy's trigger needs a second body on board before any trick can double.

restrictions.deck_construction_constraint: max 5 rare/mythic total across mainboard + sideboard

mainboard.name: Combat Research

Enchant creature

Sin salpicadura roja no hay ráfaga de doble golpe, así que la victoria es más machacona: la copia del aura de Combat Research aterriza sobre la legendaria Ivy para +1/+1, ward {1} y una carta por conexión, y el mazo gana volando por encima mientras se reabastece.
